##: Strata Terminal + CUDA engine (Windows x64). One release tag (Version, e.g. 0.2.18) carries three lockstep version numbers: the Strata app/release version, the Control runtime version (asset strata-control-<ctrl>) and the inference engine version (asset strata-engine-<eng>-windows-x86_64-cuda-cuda13). This package installs the Control runtime (flat) and the engine tarball so they always update together. The engine has no top-level folder, so extract_to points at the constant components\engine\_incoming; pre_install then renames it to <version>-<platform>-<backend>[-<variant>] read from engine-component.json, and writes bin\strata-<backend>.cmd exporting STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR / STRATA_ENGINE_BACKEND. Keeping the release-versioned directory name lets Strata's own saved-config repair (cfg_paths._newest) find it. checkver reads the signed strata-feed.json and returns the app version plus the two asset basenames; autoupdate rebuilds both release URLs and lets Scoop take each sha256 from the GitHub API digest, so nothing in autoupdate depends on extract_to.
description: Strata 终端版 + CUDA 推理引擎（NVIDIA，含 sm_120 / RTX 50 系）：一条命令装好控制端与引擎，模型文件另存
notes: 引擎与控制端都装在本包目录内（apps\strata-cuda\<version>），shim 名称为 strata-cuda；不写系统环境变量
版本对应：manifest 的 Version（如 0.2.18）是 Strata 的发布/应用版本；同包内的控制端(control)与推理引擎(engine)各自带内部版本（如 0.2.18 = control 0.1.64 + engine 0.1.64）。三者随同一发布锁步更新，本清单同时下载控制端与引擎，scoop 升级时二者一起换
引擎解到 components\engine\<engine 版本>-windows-x86_64-cuda-cuda13，目录名由安装时读取 engine-component.json 生成，升级后自动换新目录
本包使用 cuda13 变体（sm_75/80/86/89/120）；更老的驱动或 sm_60/61/70 请改用 cuda12 变体（同一 release，文件名替换 cuda-cuda13 → cuda-cuda12）
模型（GGUF）不随包分发：先自行准备模型，再用 start-model-visible.ps1 启动
启动：start-model-visible.ps1 -Backend cuda（或直接运行 strata-cuda）
pre_install: $c = @('@echo off','setlocal','rem Strata (CUDA / NVIDIA) - Scoop build: the engine lives inside this package.','set "STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR=%~dp0..\components"','set "STRATA_ENGINE_BACKEND=cuda"','call "%~dp0strata.cmd" %*','exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%')
Write-Host ('strata: engine left in components\engine\_incoming (unexpected engine identity: ' + $n + ')')
